[EN] The Worthy One
[ES] El Elegido
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Be careful. Most of the stories about him are true.
[ES] Ten cuidado. La mayoría de las historias sobre él son ciertas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You, too, will be praised in song and legend someday!
[ES] ¡Algún día tu nombre también será alabado en canciones y leyendas!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Are you strong? Are you the Worthy One?
[ES] ¿Eres fuerte? ¿Eres el Elegido?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Worthy one...I will...remember...
[ES] Elegido... Te... recordaré...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate General Virkan in the Ventral Command Center of the Divine Furnace.
[ES] Elimina al general Virkan en el Centro de Mando Ventral de la Forja Divina.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Not for a while, I hope."
[ES] "Espero que no por un tiempo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Gridus at the entrance to the Divine Furnace.
[ES] Informa a Gridus en la entrada de la Forja Divina.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
